collector_contract: Every entry is an object with a .platform. A platform the collector implements must also be listed in its SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS; anything else must carry status "declared_unimplemented" and a reason, so the registry can record intent without claiming a live source. validate_social_source_contract.js proves both halves.
